dos.text: Rely on dismiss()'s cancelable "message-bar:user-dismissed" event instead of wiring your own close-button handler, close() (and the resulting removal) only runs when that event isn't preventDefault()-ed.
Use the default role="alert" only for messages that truly need to interrupt, it reflects as an attribute so you can see exactly what's driving the announcement behavior.

donts.text: Don't set supportPage together with slotted support-link content expecting them to combine, supportLinkTemplate() renders the generated moz-support-link anchor or the slot, never both, so supportPage silently drops your slotted content.
Don't treat "message-bar:close" (fired from disconnectedCallback) as proof the user dismissed the bar, it fires on any removal from the DOM, not just a close-button click.
